Career path

# Training for AI engineers

Microsoft Learn helps you discover the tools and skills you need to become an AI engineer.

Browse the official plan for AI engineers

## What is an AI engineer?

Artificial intelligence (AI) engineers are responsible for developing, programming, and training the complex networks of algorithms that make up AI so that they can function like a human brain. This role requires combined expertise in software development, programming, data science, and data engineering. Though this career is related to data engineering, AI engineers are rarely required to write the code that develops scalable data sharing. Instead, artificial intelligence developers locate and pull data from various sources, create, develop, and test machine learning models and then utilize application program interface (API) calls or embedded code to build and implement AI applications.

## Skills employers looked for last year

These are the following skills that employers searched for last year. Select a skill to see the recommended Learning Path.

## Your path to becoming an AI Engineer

### Option 1: Self-Paced Training Work through online guided trainings paths at your own pace. As you journey through the learning paths and modules, you'll be exposed to some of the skills you need to help you get credentialed.

### Option 2: Instructor led training Choose a traditional classroom training setting to learn on your own schedule, at your own pace, and in your own place.

### Get Certified Once you have completed the self-paced training and/or the instructor led course, try a practice assessment to see if you're ready for the certification exam.

## Get connected

Explore Microsoft's agent ecosystem, learn key concepts, and find resources to plan, build, adopt, and continuously improve AI agents for your organization.

# AI learning hub

Accelerate your AI learning with resources tailored for technical and business roles to support AI skill development for individuals and organizations. Find curated AI training for any level of AI fluency, like designing and customizing agents at scale with Microsoft Foundry, advancing your expertise in managing AI workloads with Microsoft 365 Copilot, unleashing your creativity and productivity with Microsoft Copilot, running AI workloads on Azure infrastructure, and more.

* Connect with the new Agents hub
* Develop your first agent with Microsoft Foundry

  In this module, learn how to develop your first AI agent using Microsoft Foundry, a powerful platform for building and deploying AI solutions.
* Create and manage a toolbox in Foundry

  Learn how to create a toolbox, add and configure tools, verify that they load, integrate the toolbox into a hosted agent, and manage toolbox version.
* Work smarter with AI

  Take this course if you are new to AI and want to understand what it is, what it can do, and how it can support your work.

## Start with strong foundations

Build your AI fluency - learn what AI is, the services and technologies it includes, responsible AI, how you and your organization can put AI to work, and more.

* Introduction to AI in Azure
* Drive AI transformation in your organization
* Get an introduction to generative AI
* AI in your daily work: Basics for boosting productivity

## Build and scale AI on Azure infrastructure

Apply Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected guidance to choose the right Azure compute, storage, networking, and architectures for AI workloads.

* Choose the right GPU VM for your AI workload

  Compare Azure GPU virtual machine families — NC, ND, NG, and NV — and pick the right SKU for training, fine-tuning, and inference.
* Choose compute orchestration

  CAF guidance on AKS, GPU node pools, and orchestration choices for AI workloads on Azure infrastructure.
* Choose a storage solution

  CAF storage recommendations for AI workloads on Azure infrastructure — Blob, Files, NetApp, Managed Lustre, and search options compared.
* Networking design guidance

  CAF networking recommendations for AI workloads on Azure infrastructure — landing zones, private endpoints, and traffic isolation.
* Cost optimization guidance

  Well-Architected considerations for AI workloads on Azure infrastructure — capacity reservations, quota planning, and cost-control strategies.
* AI on Azure infrastructure with Azure CycleCloud

  CAF implementation option for AI on Azure infrastructure using Azure CycleCloud for HPC and large-scale training orchestration.
* AI workload design

  Well-Architected Framework AI workload documentation — design methodology, principles, and guidance for AI applications on Azure.
* Plan AI on Azure with the Cloud Adoption Framework

  Apply CAF guidance to plan, ready, and govern AI workloads — landing zones, architecture choices, and best practices from field SMEs.

## Expand your AI skills based on your role

Get ready to use Copilot and build AI apps. Discover the transformational experiences you can implement by using Microsoft's AI apps and services. Select a role to explore focused skilling resources.

* Business or technical leader
* Business user
* Data professional
* Data scientist
* Developer
* IT professional
* Low-code developer
* Security professional

### Business or technical leader

Transform your business with Microsoft AI

In this learning path, business leaders will find the knowledge and resources to adopt AI in their organizations. Explore planning, strategizing, and scaling AI projects in a responsible way.

Unlock business potential with AI apps and agents

Start or continue your AI transformation journey with foundational Azure AI knowledge and skills, including cost management and security considerations.

Find out how to benchmark models, apply multimodal models to help enhance customer satisfaction, and complete evaluations to help ensure performance and safety.

Accelerate developer productivity with GitHub Copilot Agents

This plan helps technical decision-makers evaluate AI-enhanced developer tools, improve workflow efficiency, and gain hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot.

## Discover AI credentials for every role

As AI reshapes roles, Microsoft Credentials keep pace. Earn new business-focused credentials that help you lead with AI, make better decisions, and enhance daily work.

## Review AI documentation

Discover in-depth articles on Microsoft's AI apps and services.

* Microsoft Foundry

  Explore models, services, and capabilities, to safely design, customize, and manage AI applications and agents at scale.
* Microsoft Agent Framework

  Access the new open-source development kit for building AI agents and multi-agent workflows for .NET and Python.
* Microsoft Copilot Studio

  Discover how to build AI-driven copilots with Microsoft Copilot Studio to quickly and simply integrate chat into your website.
* Azure AI for Developers

  Build generative AI apps on Azure using OpenAI Services.

Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential and excitement for the journey ahead.  

 

Are you inspired to empower organizations to transform the way they work by harnessing the full potential of artificial intelligence? We are seeking individuals to help guide customers through the evolving digital landscape, enabling them to unlock new opportunities, enhance productivity, and deliver meaningful employee and customer experiences. Join us in integrating advanced AI capabilities across devices, cloud platforms, and everyday business applications to help organizations realize seamless, innovative, and secure solutions that drive sustained growth and success in the AI era. 

 

As a Sales Specialist - Workforce AI, you will lead the charge in driving AI transformation across enterprise customers by positioning Microsoft’s AI Business Solutions—including Copilot, Copilot Studio, Viva, and Cloud PC/Virtualization offerings—as strategic enablers of productivity and innovation. You will engage business decision makers through consultative selling, develop compelling business cases, and orchestrate cross-functional teams to accelerate adoption and value realization. This role empowers you to shape customer intent, build pipeline, and deliver measurable impact while deepening your expertise in AI sales motions and contributing to a high-performance, learning-driven culture. 

 

To prepare for the role, you will be enrolled in the Elevate and Early-in-Profession (EiP) Program. Microsoft’s Elevate and Early-in-Profession (EiP) programs exemplify the company’s commitment to developing early-career talent through robust onboarding and mentorship. These programs are designed to accelerate new hires’ productivity, integrate them into Microsoft’s culture, and set them on a path for long-term growth within the company. Participants in Elevate/EiP benefit from a comprehensive onboarding experience that includes immersive training, structured job shadowing opportunities, and continuous support from dedicated mentors. By investing heavily in the first six months of a new employee’s tenure, Microsoft ensures its early-in-career hires build essential skills, confidence, and professional networks that will enable them to excel.  

 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 



Responsibilities

  • Drive AI transformation deals by conducting consultative selling conversations with business decision makers (BDMs), showcasing the value of Copilot, Copilot Studio, Viva, and Agents at Work. 

  • Act as a trusted advisor by aligning AI solutions to customer priorities, building compelling ROI-based business cases, and qualifying deals effectively. 

  • Accelerate paid Copilot growth through immersive engagements, extensibility strategies, and security-focused narratives. 

  • Partner with others cross-organizationally and support the development of end-to-end sales motions for Copilot Studio and Cloud PC/Virtualization (Windows 365 and AVD), including Intune Suite attach opportunities. 

  • Grow frontline worker (FLW) sockets and Copilot adoption, driving upsell and customer prioritization in collaboration with Digital Sales and Engineering teams. 

  • Support Agent 365、ME5、ME7 opportunities through partner-led motions and orchestrate deal closure with Commercial Executives. 

  • Engage with internal stakeholders to help build new pipeline and secure customer intent to buy by leveraging digital signals, partner workshops, and marketing events. 

  • Maintain accurate account plans and MSX updates, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and consumption milestones. 

  • Coordinate cross-solution opportunities across Security, Business Applications, Surface, and Azure, partnering with ATU, CSU, FastTrack, and other stakeholders. 

  • Uphold compliance by modeling ethical behavior, completing required trainings, and proactively identifying and escalating risks. Lead technical GTM strategy for AI Workforce.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Business, Technology, Marketing, Human Resources, or a related field, and/or up to 2 years experience in technology sales, consulting, customer success, or account management. 

  • This role requires proficiency in written, reading, and conversational English & German, as you will be assigned to the German Customer Market. 

  • Business Relationship Management: The ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with supervisors, staff, managers, customers, and vendors. This includes expressing empathy and compassion when dealing with the needs and problems of others, being approachable, taking time to address the concerns of coworkers, and treating others with respect and dignity. 

  • Consultative Selling: The ability to understand customer needs through dialogue before recommending products/services. 

  • Conflict Resolution: The ability to manage conflict, disharmony, and strife among people and situations, while recognizing and addressing sensitivities. 

 

This role is based in Ireland and has a work site flexibility of up to 50% work from home. If applying, please consider that you may be required to relocate to meet the requirements of this role.  

  

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Decision Making: The ability to make decisions in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment. This includes the ability to define, diagnose, and determine an appropriate resolution, recommendation, or decision while considering alternatives and factors (e.g., resources, costs, trade-offs). 

  • Creativity: The ability to apply ingenuity, inventiveness, and imagination to the inclusive design and construction of a product, service, program, or initiative. 

  • Negotiation: The ability to achieve mutually satisfying agreements in negotiations with others by listening to their objectives, acting as the company's representative to effectively communicate the company's objective, and seeking common ground and collaborative solutions. 

  • Microsoft Products: Knowledge of Microsoft products/services and the ability to participate in technical conversations related to products/services. Fundamental level credentials/certifications on Microsoft of competitive Cloud and/or AI Platforms.

# HackOn With Amazon 2026 (Season 6): Eligibility, Prizes, Dates & How to Apply

HackOn With Amazon 6.0 is Amazon India's engineering hackathon for students interested in coding, AI, and software development. It offers cash prizes, mentorship, and internship opportunities through multiple competition rounds.

0 min read

Amazon India has officially opened registrations for the sixth edition of **HackOn With Amazon**, one of the most competitive engineering hackathons in the country.

If you're someone who enjoys coding, solving real-world problems, or building products with AI and scalable systems, HackOn With Amazon 6.0 is worth exploring. Along with a prize pool of ₹2.25 lakh, the competition also offers mentorship opportunities, national-level recognition, and Pre-Placement Interview (PPI) opportunities for top-performing students.

The 2026 edition focuses heavily on areas like Generative AI (GenAI), software development, cloud technologies, and scalable architecture — all of which are becoming increasingly important across the tech industry.

Registrations close on **28 May 2026**, and here’s a complete breakdown of the eligibility criteria, competition rounds, prizes, important dates, and preparation tips.

## HackOn With Amazon 2026 — Overview

| **Particular** | **Details** |

| Registration Deadline | National-Level Student Hackathon |
| Focus Area | Software Development, AI/ML, GenAI, Cloud, Scalable Systems |

## What Is HackOn With Amazon?

HackOn With Amazon is Amazon India’s flagship annual hackathon for engineering students. The competition brings together students from colleges across the country to solve practical technology problems through coding, teamwork, and product thinking.

Unlike regular coding contests, HackOn is designed to simulate real-world product development. Teams are expected to identify customer problems, build working solutions, explain their technical approach, and present scalable ideas to Amazon leaders.

The 2026 edition puts additional focus on Generative AI (GenAI) and scalable systems architecture, making it especially relevant for students interested in software engineering, AI/ML, cloud computing, and backend systems.

Apart from cash prizes, one of the biggest attractions of HackOn With Amazon is the opportunity to earn mentorship sessions and PPIs for internship or SDE roles at Amazon.

## HackOn With Amazon 2026 — Important Dates

These are the officially announced dates for HackOn With Amazon 6.0:

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Event** | **Date** |
| Registration Deadline | 28 May 2026 (11:59 PM IST) |
| Coding Challenge | 28 May 2026 (11:59 PM IST) |
| Hackathon Kickoff Webinar | 12 June 2026 |
| 48-Hour Build Phase | 13–14 June 2026 |
| Prototype Submission | 15 June 2026 |
| Mentorship Round | 29 June – 3 July 2026 |
| Grand Finale (In-Person) | 7 July 2026 |

**Important:** Registrations close on 28 May 2026. Late entries are generally not accepted.

## HackOn With Amazon 2026 — Eligibility Criteria

Before registering, make sure your entire team satisfies Amazon’s eligibility requirements.

### Eligible Degrees & Branches

Students pursuing the following programmes can apply:

* B.Tech
* M.Tech
* MCA
* Integrated Dual Degree

### Eligible branches include:

* Computer Science
* IT
* Electrical/Electronics
* Data Science
* Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
* Cyber Security
* Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering
* Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering

### Graduation Year

Only students graduating in:

* 2027
* 2028

are eligible for HackOn With Amazon 2026.

### CGPA Requirement

* Minimum CGPA required: **6.5**
* Every team member must meet this criterion.

### Team Rules

* Team size: 2–3 members
* Cross-college teams are allowed
* Cross-specialization teams are allowed
* One participant can join only one team

**One important rule:**  
Every team member must individually clear the Coding Challenge round for the team to advance further.

## HackOn With Amazon 2026 — Competition Rounds

HackOn With Amazon 6.0 follows a multi-stage selection process that tests coding skills, innovation, teamwork, and presentation ability.

### Round 1: Coding Challenge (Proctored)

**Date:** 30 May 2026  
**Duration:** 100 Minutes

The first round is an online proctored assessment that every participant must attempt individually.

The Coding Challenge usually includes:

* DSA-based coding problems
* Logical reasoning questions
* GenAI and LLM-based MCQs
* Problem-solving questions

Since the round is proctored, any unfair means can lead to immediate disqualification.

**Preparation Focus**

Students preparing for this round should focus on:

* LeetCode medium-level DSA questions
* Arrays, Trees, Graphs, DP
* Prompt engineering basics
* GenAI and LLM fundamentals

### Round 2: Virtual 48-Hour Hackathon

**Dates:** 12–15 June 2026

Teams shortlisted from Round 1 move to the main hackathon stage.

The process begins with a kickoff webinar where Amazon shares the official problem statements and explains the expectations for the build phase.

During the 48-hour hackathon, teams are expected to:

* build a working prototype,
* solve a real customer problem,
* and demonstrate scalability and usability.

At the end of the round, teams need to submit:

* Project Document
* Demo Video
* Working Prototype

One thing many teams underestimate is documentation and presentation quality. A strong demo and a clearly explained solution can make a significant difference during evaluation.

### Round 3: Mentorship Round

**Dates:** 29 June – 3 July 2026

Selected teams receive mentorship from Amazon engineers and technology leaders.

This round helps teams improve:

* system architecture,
* product thinking,
* scalability,
* technical execution,
* and presentation clarity.

For many students, this becomes one of the most valuable parts of the competition because they get direct feedback from professionals working on large-scale systems at Amazon.

### Round 4: Grand Finale (In-Person)

**Date:** 7 July 2026

The top teams compete in the in-person Grand Finale and present their solutions before a jury from Amazon business units including AWS, Amazon Devices, and Amazon Pay.

Evaluation generally focuses on:

* technical quality,
* innovation,
* customer impact,
* scalability,
* and clarity of presentation.

Finalists also get exposure to Amazon’s engineering and hiring ecosystem, which makes the experience valuable beyond just the competition itself.

### HackOn With Amazon 2026 — Prizes & Rewards

HackOn With Amazon 6.0 comes with a total prize pool of **₹2.25 lakh**.

**Cash Prizes:**

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Position** | **Prize** |
| Winner | ₹1,00,000 |
| 1st Runner Up | ₹75,000 |
| 2nd Runner Up | ₹50,000 |

### Special Recognition Categories

* Top 75 Coders
* Top 50 Female Coders
* Top 25 Fastest Coders

### Career & Recognition Benefits

Top-performing participants can also receive:

* Pre-Placement Interview (PPI) opportunities
* Mentorship from Amazon leaders
* Amazon SWAG kits
* Participation certificates
* “A Day at Amazon” experience for finalists

For many students, the PPI opportunity is the biggest takeaway because it provides direct visibility within Amazon’s hiring process.

## Why Engineering Students Should Apply?

HackOn With Amazon is not just another coding competition. It combines multiple skill sets that engineering students are expected to develop today:

* coding,
* product thinking,
* teamwork,
* AI awareness,
* communication,
* and scalability-focused problem-solving.

The competition is also closely aligned with current industry hiring trends, especially around AI, backend systems, and scalable applications.

Even students who don’t reach the final stage often gain valuable project-building experience that strengthens resumes, internships, and placement preparation.

## How To Register for HackOn With Amazon 2026?

Registration is free for eligible students.

### Steps To Apply

**Step 1 -** Visit the official Unstop hackon registration page.

**Step 2 -** Log in or create your Unstop account.

**Step 3 -** Check whether your institute is eligible.

**Step 4 -** Create a team of 2–3 members.

**Step 5 -** Verify CGPA and graduation-year eligibility.

**Step 6 -** Complete registration before **28 May 2026 (11:59 PM IST).**

**Step 7 -** Attempt the Coding Challenge individually on 30 May 2026.

## Preparation Tips for HackOn With Amazon 2026

### For the Coding Challenge

* Practice DSA regularly
* Focus on speed and accuracy
* Revise GenAI basics and prompt engineering
* Solve timed coding contests

### For the Hackathon Round

* Build a balanced team
* Prioritize scalability and usability
* Keep the solution customer-focused
* Start demo preparation early

### For the Grand Finale

* Keep presentations concise
* Focus on business impact and customer value
* Prepare for architecture and scaling questions
* Ensure the demo works smoothly

## Final Thoughts

HackOn With Amazon 6.0 is one of the most relevant engineering hackathons for students interested in coding, AI, scalable systems, and software development careers.

The competition goes beyond basic coding rounds and gives participants exposure to real-world problem-solving, teamwork, mentorship, and product-building under pressure.

For students aiming for strong hackathon experience, industry exposure, or even internship opportunities at Amazon, HackOn With Amazon 2026 is definitely worth considering.

With registrations closing on **28 May 2026**, it’s a good idea to form your team early and start preparing for the coding challenge in advance.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### Q1. Is HackOn With Amazon 2026 free to participate in?

Yes, registration is completely free for all eligible students.

### Q2. Can non-CS students apply?

Yes. Students from circuital and affiliated branches like Electronics, AI/ML, Data Science, and Cyber Security can apply if they meet the eligibility criteria.

### Q3. Is individual participation allowed?

No. Teams must consist of 2–3 members.

### Q4. Can team members belong to different colleges?

Yes. Cross-college teams are allowed.

### Q5. What is the minimum CGPA required?

The minimum CGPA requirement is 6.5 for all participating members.

### Q6. Does every member need to clear the Coding Challenge?

Yes. Every team member must individually clear Round 1 for the team to proceed further.

### Q7. What is the PPI opportunity?

Top-performing students may receive Pre-Placement Interview opportunities for internship or SDE roles at Amazon.

Hackathons are no longer just coding events for engineering students.

Today, they have become one of the fastest ways for students to build real projects, gain industry exposure, win cash prizes, and even land internships or full-time jobs.

In fact, many companies now use coding competitions and online hackathons to discover talent beyond resumes and college degrees.

And the best part?  
You don’t always need to be an expert coder to participate.

## Why Are Hackathons Becoming So Important for Students?

Hackathons today are no longer just competitions.

They have become one of the fastest ways for students to:

* build real projects,
* gain practical experience,
* network with recruiters,
* and even land internships or job opportunities.

Many companies now use hackathons and coding competitions to identify candidates beyond resumes and college grades. Instead of only testing theoretical knowledge, recruiters get to see how students solve problems, work in teams, and build under pressure.

That’s one of the reasons why hackathons are becoming increasingly valuable for freshers and college students.

Apart from career opportunities, hackathons also help participants:

* learn new technologies,
* explore AI and emerging tech domains,
* improve teamwork and communication skills,
* and gain hands-on industry exposure.

For many students, a hackathon becomes their first real experience of solving real-world problems outside the classroom.

## How to Prepare for Your First Hackathon?

If you are participating in a hackathon for the first time, focus more on learning and execution than perfection.

Start by understanding the hackathon theme, exploring basic tools or technologies involved, and building small projects before the event.

It also helps to:

* work with a balanced team,
* practice presenting ideas clearly,
* and stay updated with trending domains like AI, web development, or data science.

Most importantly, do not avoid hackathons just because you are a beginner. Many students participate simply to learn, network, and gain practical exposure.

### FAQs

Yes. Several online hackathons are beginner-friendly and focus on learning, creativity, and problem-solving.

#### 3. Do hackathons help with placements?

Hackathons can help students build projects, strengthen resumes, and gain visibility among recruiters and companies.

#### 4. Do hackathons require coding?

Not always. While some hackathons focus heavily on coding and software development, many innovation challenges also welcome designers, business students, strategists, and beginners.

# Careers in research

Join a brilliant team of researchers working to solve technology’s most exciting challenges.

See open positions

## New roles at Microsoft Research

Microsoft Research provides a dynamic environment for research careers with a network of world-class research labs led by globally-recognized research scientists and engineers. Our researchers and engineers pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines, to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including computing, healthcare, economics, and the environment.

## About our roles

### Research internships

Research interns put inquiry and theory into practice. Alongside fellow doctoral candidates and some of the world’s best researchers, interns learn, collaborate, and network for life. Interns not only advance their careers but also contribute to exciting research and development strides. During the 12-week internship, students are paired with mentors and expected to collaborate with other interns and researchers, present findings, and contribute to the vibrant life of the community. Internships are available virtually, at our locations around the world, and in all areas of research. During the application process, we’ll work with you to find the opportunity that best aligns with your interests. Internships are offered year-round, though they typically begin in the summer. All internships are paid. We’ll also help with visa applications where needed.

Find an internship role

### Postdoctoral researcher positions

Microsoft Research provides a vibrant research environment, with an open publications policy and close links to top academic institutions across the world. Postdoctoral researcher positions provide an opportunity to develop your research career and to interact with some of the top minds in the research community, with the potential to have your research realized in products and services that will be used worldwide. Postdoc researchers are expected to demonstrate both independence in defining their own research strategy within a domain as well as an ability to drive forward an effective program of research. Postdoc researchers receive a competitive salary and benefits package and are eligible for relocation expenses. Our Postdoc positions are typically for a one-year or two-year fixed-term appointment.

Find a postdoc role

### Full-time academic research positions

Microsoft research teams are built with the world’s best researchers, engineers, program managers and designers who work together to seek innovative solutions to the world’s toughest challenges and improve the lives of people everywhere. We seek research candidates with PhDs and a proven track record of published papers and participation on program committees and editorial boards for our academic research positions. Microsoft Research has lab locations around the world and provides a collaborative, supportive and open academic environment.

Find an open position

## Working at Microsoft Research

### Our culture, your future

Microsoft Research offers an exhilarating and supportive environment for both theoretical and empirical cutting-edge multidisciplinary research, with access to an extraordinary diversity of big and small data sources, an open publications policy, and close links to top academic institutions around the world.

PROSE Team

We need your passion for science and your commitment to working on world-class research projects.

To help the researchers with their projects and unleash their full potential, we provide an open interdisciplinary research atmosphere with sufficient computational resources. Worldwide collaborations within Microsoft and with other institutes are encouraged and supported.

As a researcher, you have the opportunity to create and pursue a research agenda with our group’s diverse array of researchers and practitioners, as well as contribute to ongoing research projects.

### Our researcher community

Here are just a few of the people doing research at Microsoft in a vast array of disciplines and roles. Learn more about the people who make it all possible.

We are committed to building an inclusive, diverse, and pluralistic research environment and strongly encourage applications from women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, veterans, as well as students with non-traditional backgrounds. We work collectively to make Microsoft Research a welcoming and productive space for all researchers.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

## Research labs

### Africa Lab

> Microsoft Research Africa, Nairobi’s mission to understand, build, and deploy innovative cloud and AI technology addresses core opportunities in Africa. We’re contributing to solving local challenges at scale, and creating a more productive future of work globally.

Learn more about the Africa Lab

### AI for Science

> “Over the coming decade, deep learning looks set to have a transformational impact on the natural sciences. The consequences are potentially far-reaching and could dramatically improve our ability to model and predict natural phenomena over widely varying scales of space and time. Our AI4Science team encompasses world experts in machine learning, quantum physics, computational chemistry, molecular biology, fluid dynamics, software engineering, and other disciplines, who are working together to tackle some of the most pressing challenges in this field.“
>
> *Professor Chris Bishop, Technical Fellow and Director, Microsoft Research AI4Science*

Learn more about AI for Science

### AI Frontiers

> At AI Frontiers, our mission is to revolutionize our understanding of intelligence by pushing the boundaries of AI. We strive to achieve this by continuously exploring and innovating current architectures and learning signals, unlocking new possibilities and shaping the future of AI.

AI Frontiers careers

### Asia Lab

> Microsoft Research Asia (MSR Asia), based in Beijing and Shanghai, is Microsoft’s largest research institute outside the United States. Founded in 1998, MSR Asia has grown into a world-class research lab, with more than 300 scientists and engineers and conducts research in: natural user interface, artificial intelligence, cloud and edge computing, big data and knowledge mining, computer science fundamentals, intelligent multimedia, and computational science.

Learn more about the Asia Lab

### Cambridge Lab

> “At Microsoft Research in Cambridge, our mission is to transform the world through deep research. We do this by working together in an interdisciplinary way, in close collaboration with the broader Microsoft business, to ensure that we are designing robust and trusted technologies to empower millions of people worldwide. To truly understand how we can empower others, we need to put the people at the centre of what we do. I am proud to be part of a team who is so enthusiastically committed to exploring and pushing the boundaries for the benefit of our society.”
>
> *Abigail Sellen, Distinguished Scientist and Lab Director, Microsoft Research Cambridge*

Learn more about the Cambridge Lab

### Health Futures

> Microsoft Health Futures is focused on empowering every person on the planet to live a healthier future. To this end, we are responsible for research, incubations, and moonshots that drive cross-company strategy, partnerships, and real-world impact across healthcare and the life sciences.
>
> We are a global, inclusive, and diverse crew of researchers, scientists, engineers, biotechnologists, designers, social scientists, strategists, healthcare experts, and medical professionals.

Health Futures careers

### India Lab

> Microsoft Research India brings together scientists, researchers, and engineers with backgrounds in algorithms, machine learning and AI, systems and socio-technical systems that empower marginalized populations. The lab also includes a Center for Societal impact through Cloud and Artificial Intelligence (SCAI) that focuses on creating, nurturing and deploying technologies that will have large scale impact on society through deep collaborations with academic groups, startups, NGOs and other organizations that share our passion for positively impacting society through technology.

Learn more about the India Lab

### Montréal Lab

> The Microsoft Research Montréal lab strives to build machines that learn from and understand the world by bringing together researchers in the machine learning, reinforcement learning, and FATE (fairness accountability, transparency and ethics in AI) research areas.
>
> With a focus on advancing the state-of-the-art in deep learning, the lab’s researchers accelerate research breakthroughs across both existing and new models to advance state-of-the-art deep learning that has a positive impact on society.

Montréal Lab careers

### New England Lab

> Microsoft Research New England (MSR-NE) was founded in July 2008 in Cambridge, Massachusetts. The New England lab builds on Microsoft’s commitment to collaborate with the broader research community and pursues new, interdisciplinary areas of research that bring together core computer scientists and social scientists to understand, model, and enable computing and online experiences of the future.

New England Lab careers

### New York City Lab

> Researchers at this lab work together with others in Microsoft Research and in academia to advance the state of the art in social science, both computational and behavioral, computational economics and prediction markets, machine learning, as well as information retrieval. Along with helping to answer big data questions, their research will help us to understand economic and political predictions for understanding online human behavior. This research along with their study of social sciences will help to inform the technology of the future.

New York City Lab careers

### Redmond Lab

> “Microsoft Research is a multidisciplinary global organization working to create scientific knowledge and deliver innovation that leads to positive human impact at scale. To envision and build the future, we work with our partners to do the unnatural and achieve the impossible (or at least improbable), which is a lot of fun. Come join us, and let’s do this…”
>
> Desney Tan*, Vice President and Managing Director, Microsoft Research Redmond*
